title: Card Magic for Beginners
subtitle: A crash course in the basics of sleight-of-hand card magic.
description:
You’ll learn to handle a deck of cards like a pro. Skills taught include how to shuffle cards, control cards, and more. Plus learn tricks you can perform right away to entertain your friends, family, and maybe even fool a magician.

Registration includes a deck of cards for each attendee.

$49, or $39 if you register by September 1.
